mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the cleaned address against the handset revealed that the system read it correctly but excluded it from the active directory. That made the problem more interesting than a simple delivery error.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cleaning the address plate was a fairly predictable prerequisite, though the character detail made it less bland.

surprise.text: The handset correctly read the address yet refused it, with a directory migration approaching at dawn.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the repair and cleanup prerequisites made physical sense once revealed.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the contradictory records and impending directory migration affect the neighborhood, though the opening's combinations were mostly straightforward.
